tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bse khrab pa'i gtor bsngo bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ btsan gtor dmar po gru gsum pa phyogs mtshams brgyad dang mdun gyi g.yon rnams su/ 'khor gtor de 'dra bas bskor ba mtheb kyu dang sha mar dar gyi rgyan mdzes mtshon/ chu gnyis nyer mchod dang bcas pa bshams la/ chu chang gis sbyangs spos kyi bdug sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma tshar gsum/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid rta mgrin sku/ /dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ /g.yas pa thod dbyug g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /dbu gtsug rta mgo ljang gu rta skad 'tsher/ /khro bo'i rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs/ /pad nyi log 'dren gdan la brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /rang nyid de ltar gsal ba'i mdun gyi gzhir/ /me rlung dbus su btsan rta rag pa la/ /rin chen sga srab sogs kyis spras pa'i steng / hrīḥ dmar 'od zer 'phro 'du yongs gyur las/ /bstan srung bse yi khrab can sku mdog dmar/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum srin po'i gzugs/ /g.yas pa tsan+dan be con klad la bskor/ /g.yon pa btsan zhags khra bo thugs kar 'dzin/ /dbu la bse rmog me 'od 'bar ba dang / /sku la dar ljang stod g.yog dar dmar ber/ /bse khrab dmar po gsum brtsegs tshul du gsol/ /dam nyams srog rtsa gcod pa'i ral gri dang / /chos 'khor skyong ba'i stag dong gser 'od dang / /bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i gzhu mo gzig shubs can/ /g.yas g.yon glo la rngams pa'i tshul du gsol/ /stong gsum skad gcig bskor ba'i rnam pa can/ /g.yas su sku sprul klu btsan mu men mdog /ber nag dgu brtsegs dar nag thod bcings can/ /la nag zhags thogs rta mchog bra nag zhon/ /sprul pa dug sbrul 'bum sde phyogs bcur 'gyed/ /g.yon du gsung sprul bse khrab sku mdog dmar/ /ras dmar thod dang ber chen sku la gsol/ /g.yas pa zhags dmar g.yon pa ba dan 'dzin/ /rta dmar la zhon sprul pa spre'u 'gyed/

/mdun du thugs sprul lha srung sku mdog dkar/ /rin chen rgyan dang dar dkar na bza' gsol/ /g.yas pa zhags dkar g.yon pa rta srab 'dzin/ /rta dkar la zhon sprul pa dge slong 'gyed/ /rje rgyal sku mdog dmar po zab ber gsol/ /g.yas pa sba lcags g.yon pa dung dkar 'bud/ /rta nag chibs shing sprul pa dpa' bo 'gyed/ /rgyab tu yon tan sprul pa sku mdog dkar/ /dar dkar thod dang na bza' sku la gsol/ /g.yas pa zhags dkar g.yon pa sba lcag bsnams/ /rta dmar zhon zhing byi la sprul pa 'gyed/ /mtshams bzhir phrin las sprul pa sku mdog dmar/ /dar dmar thod bcings bse khrab sku la gsol/ /g.yas pa zhags dkar g.yon pa sba lcag bsnams/ /rta rag chibs shing sprul ba sngags nag 'gyed/ /thams cad bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /sku gsung thugs la yig 'bru gsum gyis mtshan/ /rang gi snying ga'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas/ /chos skyong 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ /bkra shis lha yi gzhal yas khang chen nas/ /tshur byon tshur byon rgyal chen bse khrab can/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las kun bsgrub slad dang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ /mchod gtor mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /dgra bgegs thod pa yangs shing rgya che bar/ /zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ /bstan srung bse yi khrab can 'khor bcas la/ /phyi nang gsang gsum mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs nas/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul nam mkha'i mtha' klas par/ /kun bzang mchod sprin lta bur 'bul lags na/ /dam tshig dbang gis dges par bzhes nas kyang / /dpal ldan ra ba smad kyi chos grwa sogs/ /rngog lo chen po'i bstan 'dzin bzhugs gnas rnams/ /mi nyams dbyar mtsho lta bur rgyas pa dang / /phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad kun zhi nas/ /rnam bzhi'i phrin las gang bcol myur tu sgrubs/

/bdag gzhan dus gsum bsag pa'i nyes kun bshags/ /dgra bgegs log 'dren thal bar rlog pa dang / /phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas bstan pa dar/ /'jig rten bde skyid bdag cag dpon slob la/ /nyin mtshan bsrung skyobs bya ra mel tshe mdzod/ /chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /gdug can tshar gcod dregs byed skur bstan pa'i/ /bstan srung bse yi khrab chen 'khor bcas la/ /rab dkar dang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /badz+ra muḥ bsod nams 'di yis sogs/ bgegs rigs stong phrag sogs kyi bkra shis bya'o// //zhes pa 'di yang ra smad dpon slob kun dga' shes rab kyis bskul ngor sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis kyi gsung rab las btus so// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ bse khrab pa'i gtor bsngo/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
